policy: Every timer, poller, scheduler, watcher, health loop, reconnect loop, refresh loop, telemetry loop, or diagnostic probe must declare why it exists and when it sleeps.

entries.surface: Agenda UI toast and focus affordances
entries.activation: Only after visible Agenda UI interactions.
entries.inactivityShutdown: One-shot timers complete immediately after toast/focus work.
entries.backoff: One-shot UI timers with no retry loop.
entries.sharedTimer: dedicated one-shot UI timer with interaction rationale.
entries.releaseBehavior: Enabled only for visible Agenda UI interactions.
entries.debugBehavior: Same lifecycle.
entries.evidence: Timers remove transient UI state or focus the first form field.

entries.activation: Only while the Board company view is mounted with a company id.
entries.inactivityShutdown: React effect cleanup clears the interval on unmount or company change.
entries.backoff: Visibility-gated fallback interval; P1 debt to aggregate with query scheduler.
entries.sharedTimer: dedicated fallback timer with UI visibility rationale.
entries.releaseBehavior: Enabled only for a mounted visible board surface.
entries.debugBehavior: Same lifecycle with query inspection.
entries.evidence: Interval checks document.visibilityState and clears in effect cleanup.

entries.activation: Only after a visible Channels realtime client disconnects.
entries.inactivityShutdown: Reconnect timer is cleared on disconnect and successful close paths.
entries.backoff: P1 debt: fixed 3s reconnect should become adaptive with visibility gating.
entries.sharedTimer: dedicated UI reconnect timer with visible-client rationale.
entries.releaseBehavior: Enabled only while the Channels app client is active.
entries.debugBehavior: Same lifecycle with app diagnostics.
entries.evidence: Single reconnectTimer guard prevents timer fan-out.

entries.activation: Only after a visible database admin UI record query changes.
entries.inactivityShutdown: Existing refreshTimer is cleared before scheduling the next refresh.
entries.backoff: Debounced one-shot refresh rather than a persistent poller.
entries.sharedTimer: dedicated UI debounce timer with visible query rationale.
entries.releaseBehavior: Enabled only inside the database admin UI.
entries.debugBehavior: Same lifecycle with local admin UI inspection.
entries.evidence: scheduleRecordsRefresh clears the old timeout and nulls it after firing.

entries.activation: Only while a realtime websocket client is attached.
entries.inactivityShutdown: Heartbeat clears when the client closes or becomes dead.
entries.backoff: active socket lease with dead-client shutdown.
entries.sharedTimer: dedicated socket heartbeat with protocol-lease rationale.
entries.releaseBehavior: Enabled only for attached realtime clients.
entries.debugBehavior: Same lifecycle with local realtime diagnostics.
entries.evidence: Heartbeat interval terminates ghost subscriptions and clears on close.

entries.activation: Existing UI lifecycle; starts from mounted or user-visible work.
entries.inactivityShutdown: Must clear on unmount, close, route change, or completed interaction; registered as P1 debt where the lifecycle needs tighter proof.
entries.backoff: adaptive/backoff, visibility gating, bounded request timeout, or active lease required; existing fixed intervals are registered as P1 debt.
entries.sharedTimer: dedicated UI timer with visible UI lifecycle rationale; aggregate where practical.
entries.releaseBehavior: Enabled only for visible or mounted UI work; release path follows the UI lifecycle only.
entries.debugBehavior: Debug builds may add local inspection without changing the visible-only lifecycle.
entries.evidence: Initial Idle Quiescence Contract P1 registration of existing periodic work; tighten with focused runtime proof before expiry.

entries.activation: Connector enrollment and active connector websocket only.
entries.inactivityShutdown: Device pairing exits on approval or error; heartbeat clears when the websocket closes.
entries.backoff: server-provided interval for device pairing; bounded retry delay after connector session errors; heartbeat is leased to the active websocket.
entries.sharedTimer: dedicated protocol timers with connector-lease rationale.
entries.releaseBehavior: Enabled only while enrollment or a connector session is active.
entries.debugBehavior: Same lifecycle with local connector diagnostics in logs.
entries.evidence: Polling waits on the relay interval and heartbeat uses socket close cleanup.

entries.activation: Only while a connector invoke request or browser watcher socket is active.
entries.inactivityShutdown: Timeout clears when pending request resolves, rejects, aborts, or socket closes.
entries.backoff: bounded request timeout rather than polling.
entries.sharedTimer: dedicated per-request timeout with request-lease rationale.
entries.releaseBehavior: Enabled only for active connector requests and watchers.
entries.debugBehavior: Same lifecycle with stream inspection.
entries.evidence: Pending timers are cleared in resolution, rejection, abort, and cleanup paths.

entries.activation: Only after the enabled relay child exits unexpectedly.
entries.inactivityShutdown: Restart scheduling stops when the host is stopping.
entries.backoff: bounded restart delay; P1 debt to make repeated failures adaptive.
entries.sharedTimer: dedicated child-process restart timer with service-supervision rationale.
entries.releaseBehavior: Enabled only for configured relay host supervision.
entries.debugBehavior: Same lifecycle with process logs.
entries.evidence: scheduleRestart guards stopping state and a single pending restartTimer.

entries.activation: Only while a monitor stream client is connected.
entries.inactivityShutdown: Interval clears on request close or error and detaches the monitor client.
entries.backoff: client-lease bounded refresh; no retry storm because the stream owns one timer.
entries.sharedTimer: dedicated stream timer with active-client rationale.
entries.releaseBehavior: Enabled only for an attached monitor stream.
entries.debugBehavior: Same lifecycle with additional local monitor inspection possible.
entries.evidence: Cleanup clears refreshTimer and detaches client.

entries.activation: Only while a search request with timeout is active.
entries.inactivityShutdown: Timeout clears when the search completes.
entries.backoff: Bounded request timeout rather than polling.
entries.sharedTimer: dedicated request timer with request-lease rationale.
entries.releaseBehavior: Enabled only for active search calls.
entries.debugBehavior: Same lifecycle with search diagnostics.
entries.evidence: Timer rejects the request on timeout and is cleared in the request path.
